summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded software development and low-level systems experience in C/C++ and Python across STM32 Cortex-M4, Linux, and NVIDIA Jetson platforms. Wrote bare-metal firmware at the register level, including timer-triggered ADC conversions, interrupt-driven capture, and a low-level I2C driver, and coordinated concurrent tasks under an RTOS with mutex-protected shared memory.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with a Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; eliminated sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed Cortex-M4 peripherals directly in bare-metal embedded C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1), fitting the firmware into 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Coordinated concurrent firmware tasks under FreeRTOS using mutexes for shared-memory access, integrating VL53L0X ToF ranging with OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control driven by interrupt-driven UART commands with a user override path.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures across a three-layer distributed pipeline (mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller) to reach 100% pick reliability over 10 trials at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

Deployed the Jetson-side controller as a systemd service on Linux with auto-restart backoff, non-root user isolation, and environment-file config over static IP networking; implemented two-link inverse kinematics in C++ on Arduino.

projects.name: Robocon Robot - Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles on Arduino Due, a 4-bit A/B transition state machine on hardware interrupts, driving four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM.

Built closed-loop heading correction from dual-axis encoder odometry (2400 CPR) feeding angular error back into rotation PWM; added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect.
